title: Sri Raghavendra Swamy
content: Sri Raghavendra Swamy, a renowned saint and philosopher of the Madhwa tradition.
life: Sri Raghavendra Swamy was a great scholar, saint, and devotee of Lord Vishnu. He mastered the Vedas, Puranas, and Dwaita philosophy at a young age. He was known for his simplicity, compassion, and miraculous powers.

works.title: Raghavendra Satakam
works.description: A devotional composition in praise of Lord Venkateswara

works.title: Karma Samprokshanam
works.description: Explanation of rituals and their significance

miracles: Sri Raghavendra Swamy is believed to have performed many miracles during his lifetime and after his Samadhi. Devotees claim that he answers their prayers and solves their problems.
legacy: His Brindavana at Yelahanka has become a major pilgrimage center, attracting devotees from all over India.
